content_html:
watched #TheGhost : Average!!! Good Direction, Interesting Screenplay, Good BGM, Excellently Choreographed & Edited Fights …. all gone in vain due to below average story!!!!

The content never gets you hooked to what’s happening on the screen….all the remaining factors are just saving grace to cover up the below par content!!!!

The title of the movie though powerful is a mismatch to the story and disappoints the audience who went to watch the movie after expectations from the title!!!

Praveen Sattaru couldn’t impress with the routine action format story this time, though his direction was good!!!

BGM was damn good and elevated the action parts….

Though age is catching up, Nagarjuna tried his best to fit in the role….acting wise there is nothing much in the role nor acting is expected much from him!!!!
